_comment: V5 model promotion acceptance criteria. Promotion is evidence-based only: backend/models/promotion.py verifies each requirement against actual experiment artifacts. Editing this file's thresholds does not promote any model by itself.

PRODUCTION.description: Only allowed when predefined scientific and engineering acceptance criteria are met.

RESEARCH.description: Has reproducible experiments but insufficient real-world validation.

VALIDATED.description: Has passed defined real-world validation requirements.
